bank.title: Verify your bank account
bank.whyText: A quick, secure bank verification protects your payments, prevents fraud and unlocks the full payment limit. We never see your credentials — you approve everything inside your own banking app.

bank.pendingSub: Approve the request in your banking app. This screen updates automatically.

bank.failedSub: Something went wrong on the bank's side. You can retry or skip for now.
bank.skipNote: You can verify later. Until then, payments above a limit will be blocked.

privacyPolicy.dataWeCollectBody: Your name, contact details, job requests, messages and payment records, only what's needed to run the marketplace.
privacyPolicy.howWeUseItBody: To match you with artisans, process secure payments, prevent fraud and improve the service. We never sell your data.

privacyPolicy.retentionBody: Job and payment history is kept as required by local regulation; deleted accounts are anonymized, not erased from completed transactions.
privacyPolicy.contactBody: Questions about your data? Reach us from Profile → Support.
